name: captions
description: Restyle a project's captions in one call: look (highlight = white with the spoken word in colour, or a caption style), color, highlight (the spoken word's colour), accent ({"words": [...], "color": "cyan"}: those words in their own colour; "none" removes it), position (top, middle, bottom) and size (px, small, medium, large, bigger, smaller). Writes the captions only, a version first; a caption edit since it read them is refused. Needs captions: generate_captions makes them.

input.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

output.description: {style, segments, accent?: {found, missed}, position?, size?, issues?}. detail adds the track's styling fields.

params.name: project
params.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

params.name: look
params.description: highlight: white text, the spoken word in colour. Or a caption style.

params.name: color
params.description: The text colour: a hex or a CSS colour name.

params.name: accent
params.description: {"words": ["pauses", "best"], "color": "cyan"}: those words (or phrases) in their own colour wherever said. color none removes it.

params.name: size
params.description: Text size: px, small, medium, large, or bigger / smaller than now.

params.name: detail
params.description: Also answer the track's styling fields.
